newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Suspected rebels kill two civilians in Senegal.
newsitem.headline: Suspected rebels kill two civilians in Senegal.

text.p: Armed men, presumed to be rebels, have killed two civilians in Senegal's southern Casamance province during a raid on a paramilitary gendarmerie post, an official in the area said on Friday.
The raid, on Thursday night, coincided with a visit to the region by a Europe-based delegation of the external wing of the separatist Movement of Democratic Forces of Casamance.
The delegation has been in the province since last week for talks with the movement's internal wing with the blessing of the government.

The official said the attackers, who numbered about 15 and arrived in two vehicles, appeared to want to seize arms from the gendarmerie at Diouloulou, 80 km (50 miles) east of the provincial capital Ziguinchor.
Gendarmes drove off the attackers who fled in the direction of the border with Gambia, the official added.
Rebels from the movement broke a year-long truce in March, killing two soldiers.
The revolt, which dates back to 1982, has killed hundreds of people in the farming and tourist province.
